headline: Rexford Industrial Posts Mixed Q3 Results and Raises 2026 Guidance
summary: Rexford Industrial Realty announced mixed third-quarter results and raised its full-year 2026 financial guidance.
why: Real estate investment trusts focused on industrial logistics provide key insights into regional warehouse demand and e-commerce fulfillment trends.

impacts.name: Rexford Industrial Realty
impacts.why: Upgraded future earnings guidance signals management's confidence in sustained operational growth.
